title: Amulet Rolling — Endgame Profit Craft
summary: Chaos-spam cheap high-ilvl amulets into jackpot mods. Build a per-amulet EV model — pick your sellable jackpots, price them, see true EV per craft — then log hits in one click.

versions.changelog: Rebuilt calculator: global market (Divine:Chaos + item level), an editable per-amulet list with per-mod jackpot selection and Divine prices, true EV per craft, a Breach/Delirium base gallery from poe2db, and a one-click logger with editable records (locked profit). Amulet defs + logs persist in D1.
